items.title: XRP Price Slid as Bitwise Drives $11 Million ETF Inflows
items.summary: XRP ETF inflows reached $11.31 million from October 5-9, but Bitwise supplied most of the demand as XRP tested the $1.32-$1.38 support zone.

items.title: XRP News: Emergency XRPL Patch Addresses 18T Risk
